posts.title: FrankenChat
posts.description: I’ve been doing some simple experiments probing what kind of persistent identities we get out of language models. Here, I’ve put together a small harness that carries on a conversation with multiple models taking turns playing the assistant role. This is a transcript of a chat I had through this harness with six models: Gemini 4 Argon, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V

posts.title: Computing big Fibonacci numbers using the Golden Ratio, abstract algebra, and S3 classes in R
posts.description: This post is a bit interdisciplinary. It stems from a back and forth that I had on X about ways of computing the Fibonacci numbers. I learned something new in that interaction, and I thought that it would be a wonderful opportunity to demonstrate some cool math and some cool R programming. posts.title: Wrapify
posts.description: I often find myself needing to write functions to make API calls in R. This tends to involve a lot of boilerplate and repetition. The {wrapify} package is an attempt to abstract as much as possible of that boilerplate away in a declarative way.
